name: Mary Magdalene
overview: Mary Magdalene is prominently featured in the Gospels as a devoted follower of Christ who remained present during His crucifixion and burial, as seen in Matthew 27:56 and Mark 15:40, 47. She is also one of the first to visit Jesus' tomb after the Sabbath, demonstrating her faithfulness and care by bringing spices to anoint His body (Matthew 27:61; 28:1; Mark 16:1). These passages highlight her significant role as a witness to both Jesus’ death and the events surrounding His resurrection.
